messages:
Maya P: Heads up — console shows some tenants with negative net cost after credits. ran a quick query, looks like prefetch + hotpath credits double-counting in the attribution layer.
Rohan: saw that too on tenant t-9988 this morning. The UI showed net = -$12. see screenshot.
Cait: do we have the raw per-invocation credit events? If not, coming up with accurate amortization is tricky.
Maya P: we only store compact aggregates today (per-route/day). proposal: emit a lightweight event per invocation with credit fields, but sampled.
Alex K: cardinality: adding invocation events for model_sku and route could explode. what's the plan for sampling and mapping?
Rohan: deterministic sampling by (tenant_id, route, day) using a 1-in-100 seed keeps comparisons reliable. That keeps downstream joins simple.
Maya P: suggested payload (for sampled events):
```
invocation_id=inv_0xabc123; tenant=t-9988; route=/generate-summary; sku_id=sk-00123; inp=90; out=160; cache_hits=45; prefetch_credit=30; sample_seed=42
```
Cait: note: sku_id should be an opaque id not model name to avoid leaking model topology. map table stored separately with access controls.
Alex K: quotas implication: products want quota enforcement on gross tokens, but billing uses net tokens. We need both surfaced in Console and in quota metrics.
Maya P: UI idea: default Console card shows "Net tokens (billing)" with a small link "show gross + credits" which expands a stacked breakdown. keeps product dashboards clean.
Rohan: alerting: create an automated flag if sampled data suggests (>25%) of invocations have credits > 0.5*gross for a route. That helps catch misconfigured prefetches.
Cait: backfill: we can reconstruct credits for the last 30 days from router logs but cost estimate ~1200 CPU-hours. ops OK?
Alex K: if backfill is heavy, do it only for tenants in beta. full backfill only after greenlight.
Maya P: rollout plan: 1) implement sampled invocation events (1%) behind feature-flag, no UI; 2) enable canary for 5 tenants and 1-week retention; 3) expose beta Console with sampled-to-extrapolated toggles for beta orgs; 4) evaluate backfill scope and run for opt-in customers.
Rohan: infra ask: we need a compact schema with <10 fields to avoid storage bloat. Use sku_id instead of full model name, ints for counts.
Cait: security ask: sku mapping table access-controlled and hashed identifiers in telemetry. Also add an opt-out org-level switch.
Maya P: action items: Rohan will draft the telemetry schema (incl estimated cardinality + storage cost). Alex will mock Console card with expand/collapse. Cait will draft RBAC/opt-out language. I'll open an RFC with these items.
ops-bot: Canary deploy scheduled 2026-07-02T04:00:00Z
Maya P: thanks, will ping infra to hold the backfill until we confirm cost. Good sync.
